summary: It displays the current system status using a styled card component.
It fetches the status asynchronously from a local backend endpoint on component mount and refresh.
It includes UI elements for refreshing the status and toggling a detailed modal view.
purpose: The main purpose of this file is to render a user-facing component that displays and refreshes the operational status of a backend service.
risks: Hardcoded backend URL ('http://localhost:3000/') makes deployment inflexible and requires local setup.
Error handling relies on console logging; production environments should use dedicated logging services.
The component assumes a specific JSON structure from the backend (e.g., `data.message`), which could lead to runtime errors if the API contract changes.
